notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
